get_predict_unit: get a pretrained MLIP prediction unit for a specified model name with optional inference settings and device
pretrained_checkpoint_path_from_name: download and return the local checkpoint file path for a pretrained model by name from HuggingFace
get_reference_energies: retrieve atomic or form elemental reference energies for a pretrained model from HuggingFace
available_models: list all available pretrained model names that can be loaded via get_predict_unit
HuggingFaceCheckpoint: review the HuggingFaceCheckpoint dataclass that stores model checkpoint metadata including filename, repo_id, and reference energy files
